name: magertron-submit
description: Hand an MCP server you have built to the team that governs it.

commands.title: Magertron: Submit MCP Server for Review

magertron.serverUrl.markdownDescription:
Your Magertron platform URL, e.g. `https://magertron.example.com:30444`.

Ask your platform team — it is the same address you use for the admin UI.

magertron.token.markdownDescription:
A service-account token issued to you by your platform administrator.

⚠ **This is a bearer credential.** Anyone holding it can act as your service account. VS Code stores settings in plain text — if your team would rather not have it on disk, leave this empty and run `mcpctl login` in a terminal instead; the extension will use that.

magertron.insecureTls.markdownDescription:
Skip TLS certificate verification.

⚠ Only for evaluation installs using a self-signed certificate. Leaving this on against a real deployment means you cannot tell your platform from anything pretending to be it.
